description: This file defines the NotificationPresets class, which contains a collection of predefined notification styles (presets) for an Android application supporting wearables. It includes multiple inner classes for different preset configurations, each building specific types of notifications with stylized content, images, actions, and paging.

classes.name: NotificationPresets
classes.description: A collection of static notification preset configurations, each encapsulated in inner classes for different visual styles and behaviors.

classes.name: NotificationPreset
classes.description: A base class (not shown fully in the snippet but implied) used by inner classes for implementing specific notification styles.

methods.name: applyBasicOptions
methods.description: A static helper method that applies common basic notification options to a builder, such as title, text, icons, intents, and vibrate patterns.

methods.name: buildNotifications
methods.description: Each inner class overrides this method to construct and return notifications with a specific style or paging setup.

methods.name: appendStyled
